Post Date: 2013-11-25T10:50:27Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Delete associated records
Description: Hi,

I have this setup:

``` js
var Restriction = sequelize.define('restriction', {
    id: Sequelize.INTEGER,
    device: Sequelize.INTEGER,
    user: Sequelize.INTEGER
});

var User = sequelize.define('user', {
    id: Sequelize.INTEGER,
    name: Sequelize.STRING
});

User.hasMany(Restriction, {as: 'Restrictions', foreignKey: 'user', primaryKey: 'id'});
```

This means that each User has many Restrictions. When I fetch a User, I call user.getRestrictions() and it return the restrictions associated to the user. Fine.
But when I call user.removeRestriction() I was expecting that restriction to be deleted from the database, but instead the foreign key was set to NULL.

Is there a way to actually remove that restriction instead of setting the FK to NULL?
Thanks!
